verdict.rationale: GlitchTip claims to be Sentry API-compatible, implying a usable API, and ships an official CLI for releases/source-map uploads, but there is no GlitchTip-specific OpenAPI/API reference documentation—probes for openapi.json/swagger.json and llms.txt all 404. missing for 10: a first-party API reference/spec, explicit endpoint documentation, and independent confirmation that Sentry's API docs work seamlessly against GlitchTip.
